articleTitle: Synthesis Algorithm of Proximate Time-Optimal Servo Drive with Constraint of State Coordinates
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The N - i switching method made it possible to establish analytical relations between the constraints of the state coordinates of the electric drive and the parameters of sliding mode control systems. This problem is solved for the cases of optimization in time domain and modal control. This paper presents a computational algorithm that implements a parametric synthesis of a control system taking into account changes in the levels of constraints caused by the performance of various shapes transient trajectories.

articleTitle: Stray Magnetic Fields of Toroidal Superconducting Magnetic Energy Storage (SMES)
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The stray magnetic fields of toroidal superconducting magnetic energy storage (SMES) as a system of individual coils are considered. It is shown that the stray field depends on both the number of coils, size coils, its relative position and also required dimensions and coil currents. To determine dimension characteristics, it is advisable to use the idealized model of the toroidal current surface. For approximate estimate of the stray field can be used simplified model of unidirectional current filaments.

articleTitle: Increasing Electric Network Reliability by Dispersed Generation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The article analyzes the pace of increase in the generation of photovoltaic stations in the context of the combined electricity system of Ukraine and the energy supply company of PJSC “Vinnytsyaoblenergo”. An analysis of existing regulatory documents regulating the work of photovoltaic stations has been carried out. Within the framework of the considered documents, the criteria for assessing the reliability of the operation of electric networks, namely, the length of long breaks in electric power supply of consumers of electric energy SAIDI are defined. The interconnection of the change of reliability indices of electric networks operation with the increase in the number and installed capacity of renewable energy sources, in particular photovoltaic stations (PV), is shown. In order to increase the reliability of power supply, a method of its renewal has been proposed, due to the joint use of generation of small hydroelectric power stations and PV stations.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulations in the Earthing Calculations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The following article presents the complexity of modeling and simulation process of earthing systems. There were described the solution for choice of the right model with reference to various functions performed by the earth electrodes and factors influencing this process. The exemplary results of numerical simulations were shown. At the end conclusions were drawn and listed.

articleTitle: Optimization of Operating Parameters for Examinations of Race Horses on X-Ray Tomosynthesis Units
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: It was proposed the optimization of operating parameters for digital X-ray tomosynthesis during the examination of race horses bones using a mobile system of X-ray tomosynthesis EqueTom. For measurements, a cattle joint phantom with test objects embedded in it was used. It was experimentally confirmed the contrast and resolution increasing of the test objects in slices of the tomosynthesis images of with increasing irradiation angle.

articleTitle: Numerical Model of Ohmic Heating for Random Aggregates
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The article describes methods used for numerical modelling of the ohmic heating applied in the food industry. The main challenge is related to mesh generation for a random aggregate structure composed of potato cubes immersed in the conducting fluid. The developed model can handle a cube size described by a probability density function. The maximal number of cubes in one layer is determined by the size of the tank. Using homogenization theory substitute parameters of the aggregate were determined.

articleTitle: Usage of Light-Emitting-Diode Lamps in Decorative Lighting
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The article considers the usage light-emitting-diode lamps in decorative lighting. The possibility of adjusting the brightness of the illumination of LED lamps, which do not have an integrated controller of regulating process of luminous flux, is considered. The electric circuit of the lighting system is proposed. The limits of voltage and current regulation are calculated. The estimation of the quality of electric energy input is given.

articleTitle: Modeling FACTS Device Impact on Voltage Flicker in the Electric Arc Furnace Supply System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: This paper discusses the issue of modeling voltage flicker compensation devices in electric arc furnace power supply system. Simple algorithms of modeling the arc furnace and the compensating device are presented. In the proposed model, the statistical indices of arc furnace active and reactive powers and their harmonic approximation in each time interval of one second are used. Such approach allows us to use the index <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Delta U_{10}$</tex> to estimate the equivalent effect of voltage fluctuations. The most annoying voltage fluctuations are within the frequency range of 1-25 Hz, and the efficiency of compensation devices in EAF power supply systems is dependent by their ability to reduce these fluctuations. The objective of the work is to create a simple tool for comparative assessment of compensation devices impact on voltage flicker in the EAF power supply system.

articleTitle: Transient Stochastic Processes in Power Circuits of Electric Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The analytical method for the purpose of analyzing the transient processes occurring in the power traction circuits of DC electric transport systems allowing to take into account existing stochastic character of electric traction voltages and currents has been proposed. The method is based on using a modified form of Duhamel's integral adapted to the theory of random processes, in which the weight function is determined by the solution of the Wiener-Hopf correlation integral equation. Based on relationships of the proposed method the numerical calculations of transient stochastic characteristics (the function of mathematical expectation, the function of correlation, root-mean square deviation and dispersion) of the locomotive current in freight train operation of the Prydniprovsk railway were carried out.

articleTitle: Piecewise Signals for the Iterative Control of the Voltage Conditioner
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper presents the iterative control of the shunt power electronic compensator. The single phase DC/AC inverter with PWM control is considered. The inverter generates the reactive current shifted to voltage. The required voltage amplitude is chosen as the objective function. The current amplitude is computed with the use the iterative algorithm based on secant method. The simulation results for the circuit composed of the simple grid model and DC/AC inverter is presented. The DC/AC inverter with the series inductor realize the current source. The simulations are done with the use of PLECS program. The control signals behave as piecewise constant time functions.

articleTitle: Magnetic Field Active Shielding Robust System Synthesis as Multi Criteria Game Decision Based on Particles Multi Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The robust system of active shielding synthesis method for magnetic field, generated by overhead lines is developed. The synthesis is based on the multi-criteria stochastic game decision, which based on the particles multi swarm optimization algorithms. Vector payoff calculated on the basis of the Maxwell equations solutions. System of active shielding synthesis initial parameters are the location of the high voltage power lines with respect to the shielding space, geometry and number of shielding coils, operating currents, as well as the size of the shielding space and magnetic flux density normative value, which should be achieved as a shielding result. System of active shielding synthesis objective is to determine their number, configuration, spatial arrangement, wiring diagrams and currents of shielding coils, parameters of the control system regulator as well as the resulting magnetic flux density value in the shielding space. Computer modeling and field experimental research of active shielding system synthesis carried out.

articleTitle: Video-Data Compression Using Wavelet Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: This research work focuses on researching and evaluating modern tendencies in video-compression, estimating possibilities and potential of wavelet-transform, transform at oriented basis specifically, in the context of visual data compression. For this purpose several types of wavelets (Haar, Daubechies and oriented basis) and cosine transform were compared and analyzed. Possible improvements on existing video coding standards featuring transform at oriented basis were proposed. Results regarding effectiveness of reviewed methods are presented.

articleTitle: Pedagogical Conditions of Formation of Professional Competences of Specialists in the Sphere of Electrical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the actual problem of formation of professional competencies of specialists in the field of electrical engineering. The basic components of professional competencies and fundamentals of training are considered. Described applications of the super-subject approach and pedagogical basis for training specialists in the field of electrical engineering. The proposed pedagogical conditions for the formation of professional values of future specialists in the field of electrical engineering, namely: the use of competency-based approach, the formation of professional culture of the specialist in electrical engineering and the implementation of the principle of integration with other engineering and social areas.
